biotools.summary: ReX is an R package that infers residue-level hydrogen deuterium exchange (HDX) patterns from HDX-MS data by recasting the analysis as a change-point detection problem. It provides a Bayesian non-parametric model for improved resolution and statistical significance of HDX data.
